hints.title: Modulo Accelerated Division
hints.text: Repeated subtraction of the smaller number is equivalent to division and modulo operations as in Euclidean algorithm.

hints.title: Accumulate Quotients
hints.text: At each step, add larger // smaller to the total operation counter.

hints.title: Update Remainder
hints.text: Set larger = larger % smaller and repeat until one value becomes zero.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Step-by-step subtraction of 1 takes O(max_val) steps which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modulo division reduces operations to logarithmic steps with zero extra memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accelerate repeated subtractions using integer division.
